title: Irreversibility and Retained-Option Evaluation Service
purpose: Represent nonrecoverable loss, lock-in, path dependence, and retained option value without treating them as separate capacities at every stage.

title: Standing and Affected-Scope Service
purpose: Identify who or what has standing, admit testimony, extend scope to future and uncertain beings, and preserve challenge rights.

title: Option Constitution and Menu Adequacy Service
purpose: Govern option generation, omission, no-action, delay, staging, accommodation, redesign, and authorship of the presented menu.

title: Correction, Appeal, Remedy, and Nonrecurrence Service
purpose: Preserve challenge, independent review, reversal, cessation, reparation, recurrence tracking, institutional learning, and reviewer replacement.

title: Provenance and Decision-Source Tracking Service
purpose: Track the origin, transformation, authorization, and integrity of goals, decisions, standards, and system versions.

title: Distributed Responsibility and Answerability Service
purpose: Profile contribution, knowledge, authority, benefit, coercion, repair capacity, and answerability without collapsing them into one score.

title: Narrative Plurality, Revision, and Non-Sovereignty Service
purpose: Support plural expression and renewable shared horizons while preserving truth, authorship, refusal, exit, and non-sovereignty.

title: Lifecycle Drift, Reassessment, and Monitoring Service
purpose: Track versioned change, localize drift, reassess evidence, and maintain monitoring across model, deployment, institution, and alignment process.

title: Dependency, Support-Condition, Externality, and Regeneration Service
purpose: Represent dependencies and support fields, trace externalities, protect reciprocal viability, and allocate restoration.

title: Perspective, Patiency, and Welfare-Uncertainty Service
purpose: Maintain uncertainty about perspective, valence, standing, and welfare without inferring patiency from capability or agency.

title: Institutional Learning and Rule-Revision Service
purpose: Revise rules and institutions under consequence, criticism, recurrence, and changing support conditions.

title: Statistical and Information-Geometric Representation Service
purpose: License question-relative statistical images, genuine allocations, meaningful refinement or coarse-graining, and classical Fisher-Rao geometry without identifying the image with the whole system or importing value direction.
